title: Bring documents from a service
pickBody: Pick where your documents already live. Save the service settings, then ask your coding agent to find documents and bring the ones you choose into this folder as Markdown files.
absentNote: Atlas does not offer a direct Google Drive connection here. Download documents from Drive, then use Add files.

notion.body: Pages and databases from your Notion account.

other.title: Another service
other.body: Set one up by hand in the MCP section of Agents, where the connection details live.

connectBrowser: Connect {service}. A sign-in window opens; press Allow there, and choose what {service} may share.
connectBrowserWho: Your coding agent opens that window and keeps what comes back. Atlas never sees it, and removing this connection later does not take the access away.
connectToken: Save settings for {service}. Paste an access token issued by the service.
connectTokenWho: The token is stored in this Mac’s keychain, never in your folder’s files. Saving allows these settings for agent conversations on this Mac; it does not check access to the service.
connectFailed: Atlas could not confirm that the settings were saved to this folder. Check that the folder is writable, then retry. Your input is still here.
connected: {service} setup is saved. Access to the service has not been checked.
savePendingBody: Saving {service} for this folder. You can close this window; a save already started may finish.
resumeSetupBody: Settings for {service} are already saved. Resume setup to check what is ready and finish using the same settings.
secretSaveFailed: Atlas could not confirm the token in this Mac’s keychain. Retry, or review the saved settings.
activationFailed: The token is stored, but setup is not confirmed. Retry to check this folder and finish, or review the saved settings.
setupConflict: These settings changed, were removed, or match more than one saved entry. Review the current settings before continuing.
setupStopped: Setup stopped. A save already started may finish. Review the saved settings before continuing.
setupFolderUnavailable: This folder is unavailable. Reopen the folder to resume setup, or close this window.
setupRuntimeUnavailable: Atlas could not find the local tool this service needs. Review the service settings in Agents, or use Add files.
webSetupTitle: Save service access in the app
webSetupBody: A browser cannot store this access token in the Mac keychain. Open this folder in the app, or download the documents from {service} and use Add files here.
whatNext: A conversation opens next. It searches, shows you at most {limit} documents, and waits for you to pick; each one you pick is written under {folder} and asks your permission first. Nothing outside that folder is touched.
whatRuntime: This works in a Claude conversation. Codex has not been measured for it yet, so a Codex conversation reaches this folder and nothing else.
revokeWhere: Where to take it back in {service}
noAgentTitle: The fetching needs a coding tool this app can start
noAgentBodyWeb: A browser cannot start a coding tool. Open this folder in the app to review the service settings, or download the documents and use Add files here.
noAgentBodyRuntime: No coding tool is ready on this Mac yet. The service setup is saved, but access has not been checked. Set up a coding tool, then return here to choose documents.
